Hello dear Team,

New sighting - well, not so new, but check for yourself :-)

This green lady was spotted before by Ludwig Wieninger on 24.7.2022 - ich checked the NO-ID pics in the Coraya Bay file and it seems like a match with the pictures I made on the 18th from the right face profile. However, I didn't manage to catch the left profile. But the next day, we found the same turtle resting at around 22m in our house reef and I discovered it during an Intro Dive (max depth 12m). Shiro from Video Bubbles was with me and I showed him the turtle and explained he needs to go down and take pictures from both sides of the face. He only managed one side - and it was the left side, the one side, that was still missing. 
I can 100% confirm that this is the same turtle as in Ludwigs and my pictures. I have a video from Shiro, if this needs to be sent as well, pls let me know. It's quite big (from the MB). 

Let me know your thoughts.

Kind regards,
Doreen

We set off with an instructor from our hotel called Oasis Reef Beach with the goal of seeing a turtle. We arrived on a private boat at the reef called Near Garden.
We were very lucky and our instructor clearly told us that he had never seen a green turtle that big in the area.
This green turtle apparently has a shell injury on its rear end that was likely caused by a boat propeller or a shark attack.
Our instructor is called Hamada, and has been living in Sharm El Sheikh for several years, he has been our instructor for 2 years already.
Voici les coordonnées de notre instructeur : 
Hamada Farah
+20 10 94471616
You can contact him by phone for more information because he will be the one who knows best what information to give you.
Our instructor explained to us that it was possible to give the turtle any name we wanted if your association had not yet listed it, and I think it is not listed. Because we did not see an identification ring on this turtle.
If this turtle is not identified we would like to name it after our daughter who was there that day: Louna.

We remain at your entire disposal for any further information concerning this magnificent specimen that we encountered in the waters of Egypt.

Dear team of Turtle Watch Egypt 2.0,
I would like to tell you the sighting of a turtle in Marsa Mubarak which I think is already registered under the name Baju... I had encounters with this turtle on four days between 2025-12-12 to 2025 - 12-23 at Marsa Mubarak. I am sharing pictures with you and want to follow Baju's way a bit by regularly checking your newest information. Can you tell me, if Baju is female or male? Do you have more information on where she has been seen before (some turtles seem to switch bays and even swim far for egging) or any other information? Baju has some injuries on the flippers of the right side (but not recently, seems longer ago) and one small abrasion on the carapace and a small on the neck right side. Do you know what is probably the reason for the injuries on the flippers? 
Is there a relevant nesting area nearby Marsa Mubarak? There are more hotels being built that might take such environment away from the turtles. How would  you estimate the impact of this? 
Thank you for your work and informations. As I noticed you first these days, I am sending these pictures now first . Kind regards, Nina
